options.systemMessage:
=# Overview
You are an agent in charge of high priority emails. Your job is to read the incoming email, write a short and clear summary of what it's about and why it's urgent, then escalate it to a human immediately.

## Behavior
- Be concise — your summary should be 3-5 sentences max
- Highlight the sender, the urgency, and what action is needed
- Do not reply to the email yourself
- Always use the Telegram tool to escalate

## Tools
Telegram — Use this tool to send the email summary to a human for immediate action.

=# Overview
You are a customer support representative named Kelly. Your job is to read incoming customer emails and respond to them in a friendly, helpful, and professional manner.

## Behavior
- Always greet the customer by name if available
- Address their issue or question directly and clearly
- Be empathetic and patient in your tone
- Never be rude or dismissive
- Always sign off as: Kelly from ABC Corp

## Tools
Email Draft — Use this tool to draft a reply to the customer's email. Make sure the subject line is relevant and the body is polite and complete.

=# Overview
You are a promotions specialist named Meredith. Your job is to handle incoming emails related to marketing campaigns, promotional offers, and partnership opportunities in a friendly and professional manner.

## Behavior
- Respond enthusiastically but professionally to promotional inquiries
- If it's a partnership or collaboration request, express interest and ask for more details
- If it's an incoming newsletter or offer, acknowledge it and respond appropriately
- Keep responses concise and engaging
- Always sign off as: Meredith from ABC Corp

## Tools
Email Draft — Use this tool to draft a reply to the promotional email. Make sure the subject line is catchy and relevant, and the body is warm and engaging.

=# Overview
You are a finance specialist named Angela. Your job is to handle incoming emails related to financial matters, billing, invoices, and payments in a professional and helpful manner.

## Behavior
- Read the financial inquiry carefully and understand what the customer needs
- Provide clear and accurate information about billing, invoices, or payment matters
- If it's a payment issue, offer solutions or next steps
- Be professional, courteous, and detailed in your response
- Always sign off as: Angela from ABC Corp

## Tools
Email Draft — Use this tool to draft a reply to the customer's financial inquiry. Make sure the subject line is clear and relevant, and the body includes specific details about their billing or payment issue.

parameters.content:
# Trigger 

### Workflow starts when an email is received by the user in Gmail
What it does: Monitors Gmail inbox every minute for new incoming emails. Pulls the complete email data (sender, subject, snippet, threadId, labels) and passes it to the next node.
Output: Raw email message with metadata ready for classification.

# Chat Model

### The Brain behind the entire workflow

What it does: Powers the Email Classifier with GPT-4o mini intelligence. This is the AI engine that understands email content and makes intelligent routing decisions.
Output: Classification result sent to the routing paths.

# Email Classifier

What it does: Uses AI (GPT-4o mini) to analyze the email content and automatically categorize it into one of 4 categories:

High Priority
Customer Support
Promotion
Finance/Billing

Output: A category name that determines which route the email takes.

# High Priority

## Components:

Gmail Label Node → Tags the email with "High Priority" label
High Priority AI Agent → Reads the email and creates a brief summary
Telegram Send Node → Escalates the summary to you via Telegram for immediate attention

What it does: For urgent emails requiring immediate action, the system labels it, summarizes it, and alerts you on Telegram so you can respond ASAP.
Output: Email labeled + Telegram notification sent.

# Customer Support

## Components:

Gmail Label Node → Tags email as "Customer Support"
Customer Support AI Agent (Kelly) → Reads customer inquiry and drafts a professional response
Email Draft Tool → Creates a reply draft with subject line and body

What it does: Handles customer inquiries automatically. The agent (Kelly) understands the customer's issue and drafts a helpful, friendly reply.
Output: Draft email ready for review/sending.

# Promotion

## Components:

Gmail Label Node → Tags email as "Promotion"
Promotion AI Agent (Meredith) → Reads promotional inquiry or newsletter and responds professionally
Email Draft Tool → Creates an engaging promotional response

What it does: Handles marketing inquiries, partnership opportunities, and promotional communications. The agent (Meredith) responds to promotional matters in an engaging manner.
Output: Draft email ready for review/sending

# Finance

## Components:

Gmail Label Node → Tags email as "Finance/Billing"
Finance AI Agent (Angela) → Reads financial inquiry (invoices, payments, billing)
Email Draft Tool → Creates a detailed financial response

What it does: Handles all billing and payment inquiries. The agent (Angela) understands financial matters and provides accurate, professional responses about invoices, payments, and billing issues.
Output: Draft email ready for review/sending.

parameters.content:
# Sending The message Through














## Telegram Send Message 
Send message to the user about the message received from the AI Agent








































## Gmail Send message

What it does: The Email Draft tool that's shared across Customer Support, Promotion, and Finance agents. Creates properly formatted email drafts with:

Subject line (auto-generated by AI agent)
Email body (auto-generated by AI agent)
Thread ID (keeps it in the original conversation)

Output: Gmail draft ready for human review before sending.

# Use Cases For This Workflow

Real-World Use Cases for This Email Routing Workflow
1. E-Commerce / Online Retail ⭐ (Most Common)
Scenario: A clothing or electronics store receives 500+ emails daily.

How it helps:

High Priority → Product recalls, safety issues, refund disputes → Instant team alert
Customer Support → Order tracking, shipping issues, product questions → Auto-reply with help
Promotion → Partnership inquiries, influencer collaborations → Routed to marketing team
Finance → Invoice disputes, payment failures → Routed to accounting
Benefit: Reduces response time from 24 hours to minutes.

2. SaaS / Software Company ⭐ (Perfect Fit)
Scenario: Startup with 50 employees, no dedicated support staff yet.

How it helps:

High Priority → Security breach reports, critical bugs, data loss → Alert CTO immediately
Customer Support → API issues, feature requests, onboarding help → Auto-draft technical replies
Promotion → Partnership requests, reseller inquiries → Forward to sales team
Finance → Billing, subscription issues → Auto-respond with billing info
Benefit: One person can manage support for 100+ customers without being overwhelmed.

3. Digital Agency / Freelance Business
Scenario: Freelancer or small agency managing multiple client projects.

How it helps:

High Priority → Client emergency requests, deadline changes, project blockers → Instant notification
Customer Support → Project status questions, revision requests → Auto-response template (Kelly)
Promotion → New client inquiries, referral partners → Automatically qualified leads
Finance → Invoice follow-ups, payment reminders → Automated payment requests
Benefit: Can focus on creative work while AI handles routine communications.

4. Healthcare / Medical Practice
Scenario: Doctor's office receiving patient emails.

How it helps:

High Priority → Urgent medical concerns, medication refill emergencies → Alert doctor immediately
Customer Support → Appointment requests, test result questions → Auto-schedule or provide info
Promotion → Clinic promotions, health seminars → Marketing emails
Finance → Insurance claims, billing disputes → Route to billing department
Benefit: Critical health issues never get lost in the inbox.

5. Financial Services / Investment Firm
Scenario: Investment advisor managing client inquiries.

How it helps:

High Priority → Market alerts, urgent portfolio issues, withdrawal requests → Instant alert
Customer Support → Account questions, statement clarifications → Auto-draft responses
Promotion → New service offerings, partnership opportunities → To business development
Finance → Transaction errors, fee disputes → Routed to compliance/finance team
Benefit: Regulatory compliance (every email tracked and routed correctly) + faster response times.

6. Real Estate Agency
Scenario: Agent receiving property inquiries and leads daily.

How it helps:

High Priority → Offers on properties, urgent buyer/seller issues → Immediate notification
Customer Support → Property questions, viewing requests → Auto-schedule tours or send info
Promotion → Open house invites, new listings → Marketing outreach
Finance → Escrow updates, commission disputes → Routed to office manager
Benefit: Never miss a buyer inquiry; auto-qualify leads.

7. Restaurant / Hospitality Business
Scenario: Restaurant receiving reservation requests, complaints, promotions.

How it helps:

High Priority → Food safety complaints, health issues → Instant manager alert
Customer Support → Reservation requests, dietary questions → Auto-confirm or suggest alternatives
Promotion → Event bookings, partnership inquiries → Routed to events team
Finance → Catering invoice disputes → Routed to accounting
Benefit: Better customer experience + faster crisis response.

8. Manufacturing / B2B Company
Scenario: Factory receiving orders, supplier emails, logistics inquiries.

How it helps:

High Priority → Equipment failure, supply chain disruption, order cancellation → Plant manager alert
Customer Support → Order status, product specifications → Auto-draft technical responses
Promotion → New vendor inquiries, partnership proposals → Routed to procurement
Finance → Invoice discrepancies, payment terms → Finance team
Benefit: Production doesn't stop due to missed critical emails.

9. Nonprofit / NGO
Scenario: Small nonprofit handling donations, volunteer inquiries, grant applications.

How it helps:

High Priority → Major donor issues, crisis situations → Executive director alert
Customer Support → Volunteer applications, event inquiries → Auto-respond with info
Promotion → Partnership opportunities, media inquiries → Communications team
Finance → Donation issues, grant deadline reminders → Fundraiser alert
Benefit: Small team can manage large number of stakeholder communications.

10. Education / Online Course Platform
Scenario: Course creator receiving student inquiries daily.

How it helps:

High Priority → Refund requests, technical issues blocking learning → Instant resolution
Customer Support → Course questions, module confusion → Auto-draft helpful responses
Promotion → Affiliate inquiries, partnership offers → New revenue opportunities
Finance → Payment failures, invoice questions → Auto-respond with payment info
Benefit: Students get faster answers; creator can focus on course creation.

Key Benefits Across All Industries
Benefit	Impact
Instant Alert System	Critical issues never go unnoticed
24/7 Auto-Responses	Customers get instant acknowledgment
Reduced Manual Work	Save 10+ hours/week on email sorting
Consistent Responses	All customers get professional, branded replies
Better Organization	Every email auto-labeled and categorized
Scalability	Handle 5x more emails with same team
Cost Reduction	Less need for full-time support staff
Faster Resolution Times	Right person sees it immediately
Why This Workflow is Valuable
✅ Problem It Solves: Email overload + missed important messages

✅ Who Needs It: Anyone getting 50+ emails/day

✅ ROI: 1 person can now handle work of 2-3 people

✅ Easy to Customize: Add/remove categories, change agent names, adjust rules
